claims: St. John's University is a private institution.
St. John's University is a Catholic institution.
St. John's University is a Vincentian institution.
St. John's University is in Queens, New York City.
St. John's University was founded in 1870.
St. John's University offers over 100 undergraduate programs.
St. John's University serves roughly 15,640 undergraduate students.
St. John's University has a primary campus in Queens.
St. John's University had a location in Staten Island that closed in 2024.
St. John's University has a location in Manhattan.
St. John's University has a location in Rome.
St. John's University has a location in Paris.
St. John's University has a location in Seville.
St. John's University includes the College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences.
St. John's University has an approximate 83% acceptance rate.
Many students admitted to St. John's University hold GPAs between 3.5 and 4.0.
St. John's University athletics are nicknamed the Red Storm.
Johnny Thunderbird is the mascot of St. John's University.
St. John's University competes in the NCAA Division I Big East Conference.
St. John's University men's basketball team reached the Sweet 16 in 2026 under coach Rick Pitino
